body.statement: For every positive \((n_B,n_S,R)\), \(\mathsf{Enum}(n_B,n_S,R)\) terminates, returns \(\mathrm{INFEASIBLE}\) exactly when \(\mathcal A_{n_B,n_S}(R)=\varnothing\), and otherwise returns \(\Phi_{n_B,n_S}(R)\) and every maximizing paired multiset. Its recurrence table and terminal objective list form a checkable finite certificate.
body.justification: The finite fallback closes every margin below the analytic threshold without claiming an unsupported complexity bound.
body.gap: Generic biclique search is NP-hard and the closest exact-test papers do not give a complete certificate for the structured small-margin problem.
body.consumer: Small marketplace pilots receive an auditable exact design choice rather than an asymptotic or large-margin approximation.
